subject: Cross-server session object lifecycle and writer lease management plane

reconciles.network_admission: docs/cross-server.md (MLC1 handshake, ROOM_FULL/GROUP_FULL/SHARD_FULL, PROBE1 readiness, admission quotas)
reconciles.durability: docs/cross-return-protocol.md (MLD1 SUBMIT/ACK durable/FENCE, single-writer, lease handoff)
reconciles.states: docs/avatar-lifecycle.md (PL-1): the crossServer end of a transfer settles in `visiting`, not `active`

visiting_lifecycle.create: cross admission accepted (MLC1 OK + verified entry ticket) -> the visiting avatar is created at the crossServer
visiting_lifecycle.active: visiting: provisional bounded write lease; cross-local writes allowed; durable changes return via MLD1
visiting_lifecycle.return: visiting -> transferring (final SUBMIT) -> MLD1 ACK durable + FENCE -> closed on the crossServer; the home reattaches -> active

abnormal_termination.consequence: closed on the crossServer; unacknowledged changes carry no durability claim

writer_lease_plane.lease_table: per (origin realm, character id, hosting generation) -> lease record {granted_at, heartbeat, scope, state}
writer_lease_plane.heartbeat: the crossServer renews its provisional lease on a local timer; a lease with no heartbeat past the threshold is expiring
writer_lease_plane.takeover: explicit coordinator takeover: home issues a strictly newer generation (g+1), tombstones g, grants a new lease; never auto-renewed by timeout
writer_lease_plane.expiry_reclaim: lease expires -> the crossServer flushes already-submitted changes, closes the visiting avatar, grants no second writer; the home recovers with a newer generation

admission_and_overload.onCrossVisitAdmit: (context) -> allow/deny; the application-level admission gate beyond the network quotas; runs before the lease is granted
overload_degradation_order: drain and return existing visiting avatars
refuse durable writes on a full sender queue (read-only transition)
admission_and_overload.source: docs/cross-server.md PROBE1 readiness hysteresis and the cross-return-protocol queue-full read-only rule

event_hooks.onCrossVisitStart: (context) -> nothing; the visiting avatar was created
event_hooks.onCrossVisitEnd: (context) -> nothing; the visiting avatar closed (returned or terminated)
event_hooks.onLeaseTaken: (context) -> nothing; this host holds the lease
event_hooks.onLeaseLost: (context) -> nothing; the lease expired or was taken over

four_paths.name: normal_return
steps: closed on crossServer; home reattaches -> active

four_paths.name: interrupted_return
steps: return completes only when the final change-set is acknowledged durable

four_paths.name: lease_expiry_takeover
steps: no auto-renew to a second writer (single-writer rule)
home issues a newer generation, tombstones the old
new lease granted to a host

four_paths.name: peer_down
steps: lease is lost; unacknowledged changes carry no durability claim
home recovery issues a strictly newer generation
crossServer lease reclaimed by explicit takeover
visiting avatar closed on the crossServer

mld1_zero_conflict: the lease plane is in-process and separate from the MLD1 wire; it introduces no new wire frame
MLD1 remains the only durable-return channel (SUBMIT / ACK durable / FENCE / sequence discipline)
the lease's generation is the hosting generation MLD1 already carries; no translation
heartbeat is a local timer, takeover is coordinator-coordinated through the existing lease-gate states (requested / relinquished / tombstoned)
